scope: Phase 0 Product Discovery (QUICK) for the Cal AI clone: M1 facts, M2 JTBD/segments/VoC, M3 competitors and open nutrition data, M4 preliminary economics, M5 growth engine with Growth Requirements Seed; written to projects/04-calorie-vision-cal-ai/docs/product-discovery-brief.md with a Манифест передачи

Clickable HTML CJM prototype docs/prototypes/cjm/index.html plus per-variant entry files, openable from file:// and GitHub raw, with keyboard access and mobile layout

exclusions: No Phase 1 SPARC documents (PRD, Specification, ...) — owner stops after CJM
No product code, no docker-compose, no toolkit generation
No choice of a CJM variant by the pipeline — the owner chooses
No account creation, login, or purchase on calai.app; capture limited to public pages allowed by robots.txt
No copying of Cal AI DOM/CSS/logo/brand colours into the prototype; only measured regularities
No global model or hook settings changes
action_limits: External actions limited to read-only web research, polite crawl of calai.app (1 thread, >=1500 ms delay, <=5 pages), git push to the existing branch, and Codex exec for review
Subagents: <=3 concurrent research agents (Sonnet 5), <=1 prototype builder (Opus 5), <=1 Codex reviewer; each writes only its assigned TRACE_PATH
Budget per research attempt: <=30 searches/fetches, <=45 min; one corrective attempt after a concrete finding, then escalate to the coordinator

routes.rationale: Substantive ROUTE by the coordinator: the deliverable is documentation plus a static HTML prototype (no money, no schema, no external calls in product code), which alone would be S/M; but the discovery decides the growth loop, the RAG data source licensing and health-data handling for the whole project, and the run spans research agents, a browser crawl and cross-model review. Recorded tier L for the run (consequential design decisions), while the mechanical router on the current tree reports S because it only sees changed files.
